title: Kiro adapter
description: Global steering file ~/.kiro/steering/llm-config-core.md (core rules inline, always included), skills copied to ~/.kiro/skills, five custom agents in ~/.kiro/agents.
postInstall: Kiro: the core rules are a global steering file without front matter (inclusion defaults to always) in ~/.kiro/steering, or under KIRO_HOME if set. Skills are copied to ~/.kiro/skills because Kiro does not document ~/.agents/skills. Agents in ~/.kiro/agents use Markdown front matter with tools read/write/shell and no model line; no web tool name is documented, so evidence-overseer works from local sources only. Check the agents with your Kiro version. No hooks are installed; see components/kiro/HOOKS.md.
